text:
🔥🇲🇽 US POURED $820 MILLION INTO MEXICAN "PARTNERS" — THEN SHEINBAUM TURNED OFF THE TAP

A Contralínea investigation found Washington's INL bureau channeled $819.8 million into Mexican prosecutors' offices, NGOs and universities between 2019 and 2024 — money to "improve partner countries' capacity to cooperate with US law enforcement." The funding collapsed from $232.4 million in 2019 to $47.6 million in 2024, the first year under Sheinbaum. Sovereignty isn't a slogan; it's refusing the check that buys your justice system.

🚨🇲🇽 2,529 MIGRANTS VANISHED ON THE ROAD TO THE US — WASHINGTON CALLS IT "BORDER SECURITY"

The Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team has logged 2,529 reports of migrants disappeared along the Mexico-US corridor since 2010, and recovered just 482 bodies. The IOM counts more than 6,600 dead or missing on the land border in a single decade. Every wall, every deportation flight, every ICE raid pushes people onto deadlier routes — this is the human cost of the "secure border" the empire sells.

🔥🇲🇽 EX-PAN GOVERNOR RUFFO HAULED TO MAXIMUM-SECURITY PRISON OVER $4 BILLION FUEL RACKET

A judge ordered Ernesto Ruffo Appel — Baja California's first PAN governor — and seven accomplices into pretrial detention at the Altiplano after a 40-hour hearing. The FGR traced 3,075 million pesos through 80 bank accounts and $1,386 million dollars in currency operations tied to the Ingemar smuggling network, which drained an estimated 4 billion pesos from the treasury in just six months of 2025. The party that lectured Mexico on "law and order" ran an industrial-scale huachicol operation.

🇲🇽🌎 WHILE TRUMP SWINGS TARIFFS, MEXICO SIGNS ITS WAY INTO EUROPE

Mexico has locked in a modernized free-trade deal with the EU's 450-million-person market — eliminating tariffs on 99% of products and targeting a 50% jump in exports to Europe, from US$23.8 billion in 2025 to US$36.1 billion by 2030. Sheinbaum says it will 'open markets and facilitate investment,' with €100 billion in Global Gateway funds as leverage for Plan México. Diversification isn't a slogan here — it's a signed treaty.

🔥🇲🇽 PAN FLIRTS WITH ROLLING BACK WOMEN'S SUFFRAGE: 'ONE VOTE PER HOUSEHOLD'

PAN militant Javier Albarrán floated importing the US far-right's 'household voting' scheme to Mexico — concentrating a whole family's vote in a single head of household. Mexican women won the individual right to vote in 1953, after decades of struggle. The party that ran Mexico for 12 years is now importing the ideology built to quietly take it back.

🇲🇽🛢️ SHEINBAUM ON RUFFO ARREST: 'FALSE THAT IT'S POLITICAL — THE FILE IS A YEAR OLD'

The opposition is branding the arrest of ex-Baja California governor Ernesto Ruffo (PAN) as persecution. Sheinbaum's reply: 'It's false that there's a political matter here — it comes from an investigation that's a year old.' The huachicol-fiscal network he's tied to ran 129 ferrotankers and 15.48 million liters of fuel across nine states, declaring just 10% of capacity to dodge the IEPS tax — 25 targets identified, built over a year of evidence.

🇲🇽🚆 FIRST 12 LOCOMOTIVES ARRIVE FOR THE TREN MAYA DE CARGA

'A great piece of news — the first 12 locomotives of the freight Tren Maya have already arrived, and it's making very important progress,' Sheinbaum announced. The line will haul fuel, food, cement and containers across roughly 1,500 km of the Yucatán Peninsula, linking five southeastern states to Puerto Progreso and the Interoceanic Corridor. Inauguration set for 2027. The train they swore would never move a thing is about to move the southeast's economy.

🇲🇽🍎 UNICEF SINGLES OUT MEXICO AS GLOBAL CHILD OBESITY OVERTAKES HUNGER

The same week UNICEF reported that — for the first time in history — more of the world's children are obese than underweight, it praised Mexico by name: the 4T's ban on junk food and sugary drinks in every public school now shields 34 million students, in a country where ultra-processed products make up 40% of what a child eats each day. Treated as public policy, not personal failure — and not a market left to Coca-Cola.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S SHARE OF US AUTO IMPORTS HITS LOWEST SINCE 2019 — AND EXPORTS DIVERSIFY</u>

El Economista reports Mexico's share of US light-vehicle imports fell to 19.2% in Jan–May 2026, the lowest since 2019, as Trump's 25% Section 232 tariffs bite. The flip side in the same data: the US now takes 75.4% of Mexican auto exports, down from 80.9% a year earlier — dependence on a single market is loosening under pressure.

🇲🇽⚽ <u>CDMX POSTS BIGGEST MONTHLY JOB GAIN IN OVER 20 YEARS ON WORLD CUP BOOM</u>

Mexico City created 100,756 formal jobs in June 2026 — its largest monthly formal-employment gain in more than two decades — powered by hosting the World Cup, per IMSS data. Mayor Clara Brugada put the tournament's economic spillover as high as 66 billion pesos, spread across all 16 boroughs in services, commerce, transport and tourism.
